title: skillship settings of a source repo (distros/skillship.yaml)

target-files.description: Named sets of non-skill files a `git` target in a plugin shape receives, such as the recipient's CI checks. A profile opts out of a set with `target-files: {<set>: false}`.

gate.description: Command `deliver` runs after committing and before pushing, in the source repo, never in the target clone; a non-zero exit stops the delivery. `{target}` is replaced by the path of the target clone, `{base}` by `origin/<branch>`.

from.description: A path in the source repo; a directory ends with `/` and delivers its git-tracked files. A list of files is joined in order into one `seeded` file.

announce.description: `seeded` only: a file of the source repo whose text a delivery shows the recipient when the target already holds a file of its own at `to`, once per version of that text.

to.description: The path in the target repo; ends with `/` when `from` does.

ownership.description: `owned`: replaced on every delivery and drift-checked. `seeded`: created once, then the recipient's.

rename.description: File names inside a directory `from` that are delivered under another name.
